title: Ian Bremmer Discusses Trump's Challenges with Iran Negotiations
text:
• Political analyst Ian Bremmer spoke to Newsmax on March 19, 2025.
• Bremmer stated that President Donald Trump faces a long road to negotiate a deal with Iran.
• He emphasized that negotiations, especially regarding a nuclear deal, will require time and patience.
• Bremmer noted that diplomacy takes longer than Trump may initially believe.
• He compared the situation with Iran to that of Russia, indicating both require extended negotiation periods.
• Bremmer highlighted Trump's concern over Iran's potential development of nuclear weapons.
• He mentioned that Iran has been stockpiling highly enriched uranium.
• Bremmer believes that the U.S. holds a stronger position than Iran in negotiations.
• He suggested that any new deal with Iran should be broader than the previous agreement made by the Obama administration.
• In 2018, Trump withdrew the U.S. from the nuclear deal with Iran.
